title: Stainless Steel Poker/Dab Tool No 2
description:
Stainless Steel Dab Tool No 2
A simple but effective dab or poker tool. Whether you want to launch fat dabs or just stir up your bowl this will do the job.
The No 2 has a spear point on one end and has a sharp flat point on the other.
﻿
Length
﻿  12 cm
Included
1 X Stainless Steel Dab Tool
